keyPhrases.text: The result, alas, was an honorable but bland piece
short of the originality and urgency anticipated
Tonya Pinkins has grown even more devastating

reasoning: Review expresses significant disappointment given high expectations. Despite acknowledging some positive elements (extraordinary cast, ravishing harmonies), the overall assessment is negative with phrases like 'bland,' 'ordinary,' and 'shortchanges.' The critic finds the work falls short of its creators' potential.
